target.title: improve: speed up QA report source errors
target.body:
Related: #57266

AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this change under maintainer direction.

## What Problem This Solves

The QA report source-entrypoint test spent almost a minute loading the full QA Lab runtime eight times just to verify help and argument-error behavior. This made one small test file a dominant `unit-fast` hotspot and raised its local max RSS to 858 MB.

## Why This Change Was Made

The source wrappers now parse and validate arguments before dynamically importing the same QA Lab runtime exports. Valid report commands keep the existing runtime owner and behavior; help and rejected inputs avoid an unrelated 1,655-line runtime dependency graph.

## User Impact

Developers and CI get much faster, lower-memory QA report CLI checks. QA report output, validation messages, exit codes, and valid command behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test:changed` — 1 file, 8/8 tests passed.
- Focused local grouped report: 63.620s → 3.309s wall (−94.8%); 858.0 → 184.7 MB max RSS (−78.5%); file time 59.167s → 1.080s (−98.2%); test count 8 → 8.
- Linux Testbox file time: 35.479s baseline → 0.490s after (−98.6%); test count 8 → 8.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kwp79h84r48rax9ec85v4zeh`, [Actions run 28701933469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28701933469): `pnpm check:changed` passed; focused grouped after-report passed.
- `node --import tsx scripts/qa-coverage-report.ts --json --match 'image roundtrip'` — valid source command returned matching JSON.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --prompt-file /tmp/openclaw-test-pr1-review.md --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
